policy.privacy.body: We store the minimum needed to run the service. Trips and bookings are removed after {days} days. You can delete your data any time from your profile.
demo.banner: Demo mode: data is fake. Do not use real information.
blocks.lede: Block a user so they never see your trips and cannot book you. You can unblock them later.
blocks.name: Name
reports.lede: Send a short report. A moderator will look at it.
reports.err.no_target: Pick a user or a trip to report.
reports.thanks: Thanks. A moderator will look at it.
trusted.title: Trusted contact
trusted.lede: A read-only trip summary for a family member or friend. No live tracking. No contact details.
trusted.invalid: This trusted link is not valid.
trusted.no_live: There is no live tracking. Share the trip details in advance.
trusted.share_notice: This link expires a few hours after the trip. Anyone with the link can see route, time, driver first name and vehicle description. It does not include phone numbers or live location.
contact.title: Contact (after acceptance)
post_trip.title: Post-trip check
moderation.report.title: Report
telegram.title: Telegram notifications
telegram.lede: Get trip reminders in Telegram. We send a one-time code that you send to the bot; the bot then knows your chat id.
telegram.disabled: Telegram notifications are not enabled on this deployment.
telegram.code_notice: The code is good for 15 minutes. After you send it, the bot knows your chat id and we send reminders there.
me.delete.title: Delete your data
me.delete.lede: Anonymise your account, cancel your pending bookings, and sign you out. Audit log entries keep your user id but not your name or mobile.
me.delete.done: Your account has been anonymised and your bookings cancelled.
home.hero.subtitle: Say goodbye to stressful commutes, crowded public transit, and unpredictable fares. Share comfortable rides with classmates and campus staff you can trust.
home.stats.verified_desc: Every member is reviewed by campus moderators
home.stats.cost_desc: Direct cost sharing between students, no platform fee
home.stats.privacy_desc: Contact details unlocked only after an accepted match
home.stats.trusted_desc: Share live trip view with family with zero tracking
home.how.title: How CampusRide Works
home.how.subtitle: Simple, safe, and built specifically for our university community
home.how.step1_desc: Sign up and get approved by campus moderators to guarantee an authentic, trusted student community.
home.how.step2_desc: Pick your gates, residence halls, or departments with flexible departure windows.
home.how.step3_desc: Contact details unlock upon confirmation. Share read-only trip links with family for total safety.
home.features.title: Designed for Campus Safety & Trust
home.features.subtitle: Built from the ground up to protect students and simplify daily transit
home.features.women_only_desc: Dedicated trips available exclusively for verified female students and staff.
home.features.nospam_desc: No random strangers. Everyone sharing your vehicle is verified from your campus.
home.preview.title: Live Ride Preview
home.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
home.faq.a1: Only verified students, faculty, and administrative staff belonging to the university. Every profile is manually reviewed.
home.faq.q2: Is there any fare or surge pricing?
home.faq.a2: No surge pricing and zero platform commissions. Riders only share actual fuel/travel costs with the driver directly.
home.faq.q3: How does the Trusted Contact link work?
home.faq.a3: When your ride is booked, you can generate a private read-only link for parents or guardians. They can see your route, driver name, and vehicle without signing in.
home.cta.title: Ready for a better campus commute?
home.cta.subtitle: Join hundreds of campus peers saving time and money every day.
